'Changed version' is a fair rewording of 'adopted as substituted' (c3), and the $15,000,000.00 matches c2.
The amounts and the passed votes match c15, c16, c21 and c22.
Every fact matches c28 and c29.
The adoptions and the no votes match c4-c7.
The referral, bond amount and two-week hold match c35, c36 and c1; 'give up sidewalk space' is a plain rewording of 'vacating right-of-way'.
The headline's two sewer bond ordinances and several spending measures are backed by the cited claims.
